$hashInput = "$rrlText|$parentHash|$timestamp"
$sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
$hashBytes = $sha.ComputeHash([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($hashInput))
$ledgerHash = ($hashBytes | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString("x2") }) -join ""

$ledgerEntry = [ordered]@{
    hl_id         = "HL-$nextHL"
    session_id    = "sov100-roman-run$run"
    rrl_source    = $rrlPath
    char_count    = $rrlChars
    byte_count    = $rrlBytes
    merkle_parent = $parentHash
    merkle_hash   = $ledgerHash
    sealed_at     = $timestamp
    sov100        = $true
    run           = $run
}

$ledgerEntry | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content $ledgerPath -Encoding UTF8
